create_contact.description: Add a contact to the account by email address. This creates the contact only - to add them to a list or set their properties at the same time, use Add or remove contact instead.
create_contact.name: create_contact

parameters.description: The contact's address. It has to be one the account does not already hold.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: What to call this contact.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Turn on to add them to the exclusion list, so they receive no marketing email.
parameters.name: is_excluded_from_campaigns

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

create_contact_list.description: Create a contact list to group contacts for marketing email. The name has to be unique across the account, including lists deleted in the last 30 days.
create_contact_list.name: create_contact_list

parameters.description: What to call the list. It has to be unique.
parameters.name: name

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

create_contact_property.description: Define a new contact property, so values can be stored under that name on any contact. The name has to be unique. Properties are account-wide, not per list.
create_contact_property.name: create_contact_property

parameters.description: What to call the property, for example 'plan' or 'signup_source'. It has to be unique on the account.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What kind of value this property holds. Defaults to text.
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.description: Whether the property keeps only its current value or a record of every value it has had. Defaults to keeping one value.
parameters.name: namespace

options.label: Historic - keeps every value it has had

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

delete_contact_list.description: Delete a contact list. Mailjet keeps it for 30 days with a Deleted status, so it can be reinstated - and its name stays taken for those 30 days. The contacts on it are not deleted.
delete_contact_list.name: delete_contact_list

parameters.description: The contact list to work on.
parameters.name: list_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_contact.description: Read one contact: their address, name, when they were created, how much has been delivered to them and whether they are excluded from marketing email.
get_contact.name: get_contact

parameters.description: The contact's id. Use List contacts to find one. Mailjet ids are numbers; a link copied from the Mailjet dashboard works too.
parameters.name: contact_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_contact_properties.description: Read the property values stored on one contact, as a set of name/value pairs a later step can read straight out of.
get_contact_properties.name: get_contact_properties

parameters.description: The contact's id. Use List contacts to find one. Mailjet ids are numbers; a link copied from the Mailjet dashboard works too.
parameters.name: contact_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_statistics.description: Read Mailjet's sending statistics - sent, opened, clicked, bounced, spam and unsubscribe counts - for the whole account, one campaign, one contact list or one sender, over all time or bucketed by day, hour or five minutes.
get_statistics.name: get_statistics

parameters.description: What to report on. Defaults to the whole account, which needs no id and no dates.
parameters.name: counter_source

parameters.description: How finely to bucket the numbers. Defaults to all time, which is the only setting that needs no dates. A contact list can only be read over all time.
parameters.name: counter_resolution

parameters.description: Whether to count by when the message was sent or by when the event happened. Counting by event cannot be grouped over all time.
parameters.name: counter_timing

parameters.description: Which campaign, contact list or sender to report on. Required unless the statistics are for the whole account. Mailjet ids are numbers; a link copied from the Mailjet dashboard works too.
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.description: Only include records from this moment onwards.
parameters.name: from_datetime

parameters.description: Only include records up to this moment.
parameters.name: to_datetime

counter_timing.description: What the numbers were timed against

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_contact_lists.description: List the account's contact lists with how many contacts each holds. This is how you find a list's id.
list_contact_lists.name: list_contact_lists

parameters.description: Only the list with exactly this name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Only the list with this Mailjet-generated address (the part before @lists.mailjet.com).
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: Whether to return only deleted lists, only live ones, or all of them. A deleted list stays reinstatable for 30 days.
parameters.name: is_deleted

parameters.description: Omit one list from the result. Mailjet ids are numbers; a link copied from the Mailjet dashboard works too.
parameters.name: exclude_list_id

parameters.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 10, at most 1000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before returning any. Use it with 'How many to return' to read the next page.
parameters.name: offset

list_ids.description: The ids of those records, in the same order

list_names.description: Their names, in the same order

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_contact_properties.description: List the contact properties defined on this account - the custom fields a contact can carry - with the kind of value each one holds.
list_contact_properties.name: list_contact_properties

parameters.description: What kind of value this property holds. Defaults to text.
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.description: Whether the property keeps only its current value or a record of every value it has had. Defaults to keeping one value.
parameters.name: namespace

options.label: Historic - keeps every value it has had

parameters.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 10, at most 1000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before returning any. Use it with 'How many to return' to read the next page.
parameters.name: offset

property_names.description: Their names, in the same order

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_contact_subscriptions.description: List the contact lists one contact is on, and whether they have unsubscribed from each. Lists deleted in the last 60 days appear too, because Mailjet can still reinstate them.
list_contact_subscriptions.name: list_contact_subscriptions

parameters.description: The contact's id. Use List contacts to find one. Mailjet ids are numbers; a link copied from the Mailjet dashboard works too.
parameters.name: contact_id

list_ids.description: The ids of those records, in the same order

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_contacts.description: List the contacts in this Mailjet account, optionally only those on one contact list or only those excluded from marketing email. This is how you find a contact's id.
list_contacts.name: list_contacts

parameters.description: Only contacts on this list. Leave empty for every contact in the account.
parameters.name: contact_list_id

parameters.description: Whether to return only contacts excluded from marketing email, only those not excluded, or all of them.
parameters.name: is_excluded_from_campaigns

options.label: Only contacts not excluded from campaigns

parameters.description: Only contacts active since this moment.
parameters.name: last_activity_after

parameters.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 10, at most 1000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before returning any. Use it with 'How many to return' to read the next page.
parameters.name: offset

contact_emails.description: Their email addresses, in the same order

contact_ids.description: The ids of those records, in the same order

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_messages.description: List the emails this Mailjet account has sent, newest first, with what happened to each one. Filter by contact, by your own reference, by delivery status or by when they were sent.
list_messages.name: list_messages

parameters.description: Only messages sent to this contact id. Leave empty for all contacts. Mailjet ids are numbers; a link copied from the Mailjet dashboard works too.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: Only messages carrying this reference - the CustomID set on the message when it was sent.
parameters.name: custom_id

parameters.description: Only messages in this state.
parameters.name: message_status

parameters.description: Only transactional or only marketing email.
parameters.name: from_type

parameters.description: Only include records from this moment onwards.
parameters.name: from_datetime

parameters.description: Only include records up to this moment.
parameters.name: to_datetime

parameters.description: Mailjet leaves the subject out of this list unless it is asked for.
parameters.name: show_subject

parameters.description: Mailjet leaves your reference out of this list unless it is asked for.
parameters.name: show_custom_id

parameters.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 10, at most 1000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before returning any. Use it with 'How many to return' to read the next page.
parameters.name: offset

message_ids.description: The ids of those records, in the same order

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_senders.description: List the sender addresses and domains registered on this account and the status of each - Active, Inactive or Deleted - so a workflow can check that an address is still verified and see which domains the account is set up for.
list_senders.name: list_senders

parameters.description: Only the sender with this address.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Only senders on this domain.
parameters.name: domain

parameters.description: Only senders in this state. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Turn on to include senders that were removed.
parameters.name: show_deleted

parameters.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 10, at most 1000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before returning any. Use it with 'How many to return' to read the next page.
parameters.name: offset

sender_emails.description: The addresses a message can be sent from: active, and not a whole-domain sender

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_templates.description: List the email templates available to this account - their ids, names, categories, locale and when each was last updated. Use it to audit which templates exist or to find the id of one.
list_templates.name: list_templates

parameters.description: Only templates with this name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Whose templates to return. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: owner_type

parameters.description: Only templates marked for these purposes. A template with no purpose set is invisible in the Mailjet app.
parameters.name: purposes

parameters.description: Only templates built in this Mailjet editor.
parameters.name: edit_mode

parameters.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 10, at most 1000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before returning any. Use it with 'How many to return' to read the next page.
parameters.name: offset

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

template_ids.description: The ids of those records, in the same order

manage_list_contact.description: Add a contact to one list, remove them from it, or unsubscribe them - by email address, so the contact does not have to exist yet. Mailjet creates a new contact and sets their name and properties in the same call.
manage_list_contact.name: manage_list_contact

parameters.description: The contact list to work on.
parameters.name: list_id

parameters.description: The contact's address. Mailjet creates the contact if the account does not have them yet.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Whether to add, remove or unsubscribe them.
parameters.name: action

options.label: Add and subscribe, even if they unsubscribed before
Add, keeping their current subscription status

parameters.description: What to call the contact. Sets or updates their name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Values to store on the contact, one field per property the account has defined.
parameters.name: properties

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

update_contact.description: Change a contact's name, or whether they are excluded from marketing email. Anything left empty is left as it is. A contact's email address cannot be changed - Mailjet does not allow it.
update_contact.name: update_contact

parameters.description: The contact's id. Use List contacts to find one. Mailjet ids are numbers; a link copied from the Mailjet dashboard works too.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: New name. Leave empty to keep the current one.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Turn on to exclude them from marketing email, off to let it through. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
parameters.name: is_excluded_from_campaigns

changed.description: False when the contact already had these values

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

update_contact_properties.description: Set property values on one contact. Each property has to exist on the account first - create it with Create contact property. Properties not listed are left as they are.
update_contact_properties.name: update_contact_properties

parameters.description: The contact's id. Use List contacts to find one. Mailjet ids are numbers; a link copied from the Mailjet dashboard works too.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: The properties to set, each a name and the value to store. The name has to match a contact property that already exists - List contact properties shows them.
parameters.name: properties

changed.description: False when the values were already stored

properties.description: Property name to value, after the update

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

description: Manage Mailjet contacts, lists and contact properties, and read the templates, senders, delivery records and statistics of the account.
